title: alert
description: One detection, written in plain language for someone who is not a network expert. Repeats from the same rule and device within a cooldown update one alert instead of adding another.

ts.description: Time of the triggering record, epoch seconds.

device.description: IP address the alert is about.

title.description: A few words, for a list or popup heading.

flow_ids.description: flow_id of each flow record used as evidence; may be empty.

evidence.description: Rule-specific numbers behind the alert, e.g. {"ports": 214, "window_seconds": 5}.
